text: Caixa Popular is a Valencian cooperative bank whose owners are its worker-members.
short: Caixa Popular is a cooperative bank owned by its worker-members.

source.name: Caixa Popular: 'Quiénes somos / Sobre la entidad'
source.quote: En Caixa Popular, los propietarios somos los mismos compañeros y compañeras de trabajo
